decisions.reason: The shift to a formatting pass on a supplied final draft may replace the earlier obligation to package disparate content, but the source could also mean that full-document content integration remains valid within the narrower layout service.
Photo integration into the final proposal draft is separately and fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; the table-specific change requires no additional modification.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the final-draft stage, single layout pass, and full-document coverage; the table-integration change does not require another layout-state update.
Integrating supplied tables into the formatted proposal does not change the independently established print-ready PDF delivery format.
The source's table-integration decision does not alter the independently established use of GreenLatinos brand colors and fonts at this point in history.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ project and does not change the TPEC proposal-design requirement.
The table-integration stage and treatment do not alter the independently established single revision round.
The source does not change the submission deadline or preferred submission date.
The simplified table-integration treatment does not revise or cancel the anticipated page count.
